Your workspace

Account reference for support

Open Guided IC/LC Inquiry
Your first session · three quick steps
  1. Open the inquiry workspace and start from the beginning, or resume a local recovery file.
  2. Use participant codes. Keep source documents and signed records with your institution.
  3. Save a recovery file before leaving; it includes recorded workflow choices and dates, not downloaded Word files or selected evidence files.

Access and renewals

Renewal is manual. Request a written scope and fee before payment; an enquiry does not extend access. Save a recovery file before access ends. Downloaded files remain on your device.

Waiting for access or renewal? Contact account support using your approved email and purchase reference. Your account reference is available above if requested. Choose Check access again after confirmation. Do not send case details.

Optional authenticator sign-in

Email-code sign-in does not require an authenticator. These controls are for password sign-in.

Authenticator verification

Use an authenticator app for a second sign-in check. Password sign-in requires this additional verification; email-code sign-in already verifies access without it. Keep your account recovery arrangements with your plan provider.

Add this setup key manually in your authenticator app. Keep it private; it is shown only for setup.

Assign customer plan access
Find the customer by email, then choose the verified plan and access dates. A customer must have a confirmed Navigator sign-in account first.
Check the spelling. If the account is new, open the Navigator authentication dashboard and add or invite the customer under Users. Once their email is confirmed, return here and select Find confirmed account again.
